_about: Data for the samosa station (design system §15), the combined station js/cook/stations/samosa.js: six pastry strips on the board at every level (SAM-25): tap any, fill it from the shelf's filling heaps (a spoonful per tap), one tick when done; then fold each filled strip by swiping (SAM-21: the coded fold in the pastry texture, js/cook/mechanics/fill-fold.js Cook.Pastry), then fry them in the karahi on the kitchen kit's wide hob and lift each onto the paper-lined plate when golden. Serve and taste (§14a). The fill's decoys are the level table's, the fold's swipes data.mechanics.fold (folds, minLen), the fry's speed and golden band data.mechanics.fry (by level). `phases`: one English line per job for the grown-ups (placeholders, like every station goal) and the phase button's label.

station.name: Samosa
station.goal: Fill as many strips as they asked for with what they said, tap the tick, fold each one, then fry them golden.

phases.fill: Tap a strip, then the fillings: one spoon each tap, as many spoons as they said. Fill as many strips as they asked for, then tap the tick.
phases.fold: Swipe the way the arrow shows to fold each samosa. Then they go to the karahi.
phases.fry: Turn on the hob, put the samosas in, and lift each one out when it's golden.
